title: Audit the actual compression suffix against the global normalized tensor map
body:
PR3935's compression error statement needs its local Core defect bound to apply to every actual computed input and to the correct global coordinates. This package independently audits that implication: original floor-defined core partitions, zero-padded output slots, all-halos-first execution, full mixed-radix spectator lines and final assembly. It preserves numerical axis order and commutes only copies/zero embeddings across another axis.

Under the explicitly inherited PR3851 uniform local defect delta_i<2h and exact global operator norm<=1/8, it proves computed-domain and error recurrences r_(i+1)<=r_i/8+delta_i and e_(i+1)<=e_i/8+delta_i. The local defect is evaluated on the computed input; no linearity or Lipschitz property of rounded Core is assumed. The common-grid suffix bound is 8^-D e_0+(16/7)(1-8^-D)h, before exact2^gamma restoration. This does not change the production precision or paid invoice.

The checker authenticates and extracts the six existing post-chirp/pre-restoration statements from Tensor.run, with original numerical owners. On the immutable p48/P80 catalogue it checks96 actual Core returns against independent signed staged arithmetic and all49 final complex records against a natural-coordinate model. It records both halo passes, both compression axes and both assemblies, borrowed-input preservation and scratch erasure. Wrong final layout and premature restricted-axis reuse are distinguished. The p48 pages have reduced halos and boundary-only cells: this is finite conformance, not production accuracy or a successful complete Tensor invocation.

Validation at4c49fff7fdfa4ddda6ef615575b6762b3f46f9cd: normal physical replay, the final strengthened rounding control, package metadata/pins, official49file committed-byte/source-history and export integrity pass. A separate read-only AI peer inspected the proof and actual source callers; its only minor control suggestion was implemented. Git-free optimized replay passes in73.153s; source and wrong-signed-solve model mutations reject in0.068s/7.947s, respectively, with all49 exported file bytes restored.

This answers the source/physical-correspondence question in PR3935's Open next questions and Discussion3664. PR5056's expansion-only norm proof, PR5059's changed blocked boundary ABI and the existing scalar compression-error-sum are distinct; none is repeated or substituted here. The separately assigned CRT recovery task retains its own conditional Tensor bound.

Remaining premises include original production Gaussian locality/interval/old-H/Schur bounds, stored-width/word/native correctness and full CRT recovery. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance, complete multiplication theorem, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. All source setup, halo movement, numerical calls, padding, protected-return copies and erasure costs remain paid.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR3935/3851, Chafik Boukhalfa PR489 and predecessors, Dugongue, RaD/hipotures and the retained Gaussian/chirp/word/Harvey–van der Hoeven/manuscript lineage. Frozen sources/notices are unchanged; the existing catalogue grammar parser is reused and numerical model is independent. JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

Submission checkpoint: canonical main remains `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, with guidance, selected record and declared source inputs unchanged. Shared complete text coverage includes330 open PR bodies at08:11UTC,4195 Discussion records at08:12UTC and6760 tracked notes; focused changed-source searches found no matching new reservation. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside this advisory coverage.
